# ShaadDev Studio

> ShaadDev Studio is a collection of free, browser-based tools for images, video, audio, PDFs, text and design, plus small browser games and mobile apps by the studio. No account is needed. Most tools process your files inside your own browser tab instead of uploading them.

Every tool is free and runs in a modern web browser; no sign-in is needed. Each tool page has a "Quick facts" section (input, output, limits, privacy) and an FAQ. Full details for every tool: https://shaaddev.studio/llms-full.txt

## Hire: freelance mobile and web app developer

Rizwan Rasheed (Software Engineer, ShaadDev Studio) is a freelance developer for iPhone and Android apps (Flutter, React Native), web apps (React, Next.js, TypeScript), full-stack backends (Node.js, Go, Laravel, AWS) and AI features. 5+ years of production work; available for new projects. Based in Pakistan, working remotely with clients worldwide (remote first). No published prices: quotes per project. Contact: https://shaaddev.studio/contact. Profiles: https://github.com/Rizwan884 , https://www.linkedin.com/in/rashidrizwan-connect/

- [Hire Rizwan Rasheed](https://shaaddev.studio/hire): who he is, services, live proof, how he works, contact, FAQ.
- [Mobile app development (iPhone and Android)](https://shaaddev.studio/services/mobile-app-development): Rizwan Rasheed builds cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and React Native (and SwiftUI or Kotlin Multiplatform where native fits better), from first screens to App Store and Google Play release. 21 of the studio's own apps are live in the stores today, plus enterprise apps for clients.
- [Web app development](https://shaaddev.studio/services/web-development): Rizwan Rasheed builds fast, responsive web apps with React, Next.js and TypeScript, backed by Node.js, Go or Laravel APIs: dashboards, SaaS tools, fintech forms with CRM integrations and payment flows.
- [Flutter app development](https://shaaddev.studio/services/flutter-development): Rizwan Rasheed has built production Flutter apps since 2020 (Mercury Sols, then Kairos Business Solutions Singapore) and ships the studio's own Flutter apps to Google Play, with localization, subscriptions, ads and store release.
- [React and Next.js development](https://shaaddev.studio/services/react-development): Rizwan Rasheed builds React and Next.js front ends in TypeScript with Tailwind CSS, plus React Native for mobile. Live examples include the Win Your PIP Next.js site with Stripe and this site's React tool suite.
- [Full-stack and AI feature development](https://shaaddev.studio/services/full-stack-ai-development): Rizwan Rasheed builds the whole product, app plus backend (Node.js, Go, Laravel, cloud) and integrates AI: chat assistants, voice cloning and text to speech, text-to-image, camera scanners that identify and value items, AI body scans.

## Images & Media

- [GIF Online Viewer](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/gif-viewer): Upload any GIF to pause, scrub frame-by-frame, and extract absolute high-definition PNG frame slices locally.
- [Video to GIF Maker](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/video-to-gif): Convert any video into an exceptionally high-quality animated GIF instantly. 100% offline edge-processing running locally in your browser.
- [Video to Images](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/video-to-images): Convert any video into a full sequence of high-quality images. Set a custom frame rate, preview every frame, and download one image or the entire batch as a ZIP.
- [Bulk Image Resizer](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/image-resizer): Batch resize multiple images at once instantly in your browser without uploading to any server.
- [Smart Image Compressor](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/image-compressor): Compress JPEG, PNG, and WebP images locally with maximum size savings and zero visible quality loss.
- [Bulk Image Enhancer](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/bulk-image-enhancer): Edit bulk images quickly. Apply Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, and other real-time filters instantly to all your photos.
- [AuraCut AI](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/background-remover): Instantly isolate backgrounds using our local neural engine. Features DP Makers, layer filters, and pro studio drop-shadows.
- [Event Slideshow](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/event-slideshow): Turn your event folders into a full-screen slideshow with crossfade transitions, slow zoom/pan on photos, background music, and title cards. Works for weddings, birthdays, or any occasion.

## Utilities

- [QR Code Generator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/qr-code-generator): Generate high-res QR codes instantly for URLs, text, and contact info.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/pomodoro-timer): Boost productivity with our sleek customizable Pomodoro technique timer.
- [Keyword Research Tool](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/keyword-research): Find long-tail keyword ideas from Google, YouTube, Bing and DuckDuckGo search suggestions.
- [YT Thumbnail Saver](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/yt-thumbnail): Fetch max-resolution YouTube video thumbnails directly to your device.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/password-generator): Instantly create strong, random, and highly secure passwords with customizable parameters to keep data safe.

## Calculators

- [Age Calculator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/age-calculator): Calculate your exact age in years, months, days, and seconds.
- [Unit Converter](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/unit-converter): Convert length, weight, temperature, data, and more effortlessly.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/percentage-calculator): Calculate percentage changes, discounts, tips, and financial math safely.

## Design

- [Color Palette Gen](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/color-palette): Create beautiful trending color schemes for your UI/UX designs.
- [CSS Gradient Generator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/css-gradient): Visually create and export fluid CSS linear gradients instantly.
- [ASO Screenshot Pro](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/aso-screenshot): Create polished App Store and Play Store screenshots with customizable layouts, text, colors, and device sizes.

## Text

- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/lorem-ipsum): Generate customizable, high-quality placeholder dummy text.
- [Text Utilities](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/text-utilities): A complete suite for your text: word count, character count, case switching, and Base64 encoding/decoding.

## Development

- [Markdown to HTML](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/markdown-to-html): Convert Markdown strings into clean, formatted HTML code instantly.
- [JSON Formatter](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/json-formatter): Quickly format, validate, and beautify your raw JSON responses. Perfect for debugging messy API payloads.

## Documents & Files

- [Audio Merger Pro](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/audio-merger): Merge multiple audio files (MP3, WAV, M4A) securely in your browser without uploading data to servers.
- [Smart PDF Compressor](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/pdf-compressor): Shrink PDF files offline with lossless optimization or smart photo compression. Preview results and rename every output before downloading.
- [File to PDF Converter](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/file-to-pdf): Convert images, CSV, Excel, Word (.docx), and text files into clean PDFs. Rename every output and download one at a time or all as a ZIP — 100% offline.
- [Secure PDF Merger](https://shaaddev.studio/tools/pdf-merger): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file quickly, securely, and completely offline.

## Mobile apps (Android and iPhone)

Mobile apps published by ShaadDev Studio (developer "shaad dev studio" on Google Play, "Rizwan Rashid" on the App Store). Every listed app was live in its store on the date in "checked". Features, pricing and privacy facts are taken from each app's own store listing and the developer's Play Data safety / App Store privacy declarations. Overview: https://shaaddev.studio/apps

- [Text-to-speech and voice cloning apps](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/category/text-to-speech): ShaadDev Studio's three AI voice apps for text to speech and voice cloning on Android and iPhone, compared by platform, features, export and pricing model.
- [AI image and prompt apps](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/category/ai-images-and-prompts): ShaadDev Studio's AI image apps: one text-to-image generator and four AI prompt libraries for photos, videos, logos and text models.
- [Scanner apps for collectors](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/category/collectible-scanners): ShaadDev Studio's photo scanner apps for collectors: a sports card scanner with sold-price values and a stamp identifier with estimated values.
- [Volume limiter and screen dimmer apps](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/category/volume-and-screen-control): ShaadDev Studio's Android and iPhone apps to cap or lock volume for kids, lock brightness, and dim the screen below the minimum at night.

- [AI Voice Clone & Text-to-Speech Studio](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/fish-audio) (Android, iOS): Clone your voice from a short recording and turn text into natural speech on Android and iPhone.
- [Mimicly: AI Voice Changer & Voice Clone](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/mimicly) (Android): Android app to clone your own voice, turn scripts into speech and change your voice for short videos.
- [VoiceTwin AI: Voice Cloning](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/voice-cloning) (iOS): iPhone app for text to speech with 300+ voices in several languages and cloning your own voice.
- [PixelForge - Text to Image AI](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/pixelforge) (iOS): iPhone text-to-image AI app that makes up to 8 variations of an idea in one tap.
- [PhotoGem: AI Pix Video Prompts](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/photogem) (Android): Android gallery of 500+ ready-to-copy prompts for AI photos and AI videos.
- [PromptGenius: AI Prompts](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/promptgenius) (Android, iOS): Prompt library and prompt builder for chat and image AI models, for work topics like SEO, marketing and coding.
- [PixPrompter: AI Prompt Library](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/pixprompter) (iOS): iPhone library of 1,000+ copy-ready prompts for AI profile pictures, logos and stickers.
- [PromptCraft: AI Photo Editing](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/promptcraft) (iOS): iPhone collection of copy-paste prompts for AI photo editing styles like cinematic, retro and studio portraits.
- [CardVault: Sports Card Scanner](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/cardvault) (Android, iOS): Scan a sports card with your phone camera to identify it and see its value from recent sold prices.
- [Stamp ID: Scanner & Value](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/stamp-id) (iOS): iPhone stamp identifier: scan a postage stamp to learn its origin, year and estimated value.
- [Volume Lock: Parental Control](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/volume-lock) (Android, iOS): Set a maximum volume on your child's phone or tablet and protect it with a PIN.
- [Volume Locker](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/volume-locker) (Android): Android app that locks volume and brightness levels so they do not change by accident, with PIN and auto silent.
- [Dimmer: Night Screen OLED Lens](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/dimmer) (Android): Dim your Android screen below the lowest system brightness for reading in the dark.
- [FlashPad – Quick Notes](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/flashpad) (Android): Offline Android quick notes that delete themselves after a time you choose and detect phone numbers, links and addresses.
- [IncomeMap: Income & Expenses](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/incomemap) (iOS): iPhone expense tracker and budget planner with loan tracking and PDF receipts.
- [BDVibes: Birthday Reminders](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/bdvibes) (Android, iOS): Birthday and anniversary reminder app with countdowns and age tracking.
- [Footprint: Username Checker](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/footprint-check) (Android): Check your own username on 45 sites to find old accounts and see your digital footprint.
- [Fyzik: Body Scan & AI Workout Planner](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/fyzik) (Android): Take an AI body scan with your phone camera and get a gym or home workout plan that updates with each scan.
- [Riz Word: Calm Letter Puzzle](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/riz-words) (Android): Relaxing word puzzle: swipe a ring of letters to find hidden words, with no timer.
- [CineLUT – Photo & Video LUTs](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/cinelut) (Android): Offline Android app with 500 LUT color presets for photos and videos, with .cube export.
- [RYK Hub: Rahim Yar Khan App](https://shaaddev.studio/apps/ryk-hub) (Android): City app for Rahim Yar Khan, Pakistan: electric bus routes and schedules, local services and business listings.
